cases.query: MATCH (a:PERSON)-[:ISLOCATEDIN]->(cityA:PLACE)-[:ISPARTOF]->(country:PLACE {name: $country}), (a)-[:KNOWS]-(b:PERSON) WHERE cityA.type = 'City' AND country.type = 'Country' AND a.id < b.id WITH DISTINCT country, a, b MATCH (b)-[:ISLOCATEDIN]->(cityB:PLACE)-[:ISPARTOF]->(country) WHERE cityB.type = 'City' WITH DISTINCT country, a, b RETURN a.id AS a, b.id AS b, country.id AS c
cases.output: MATCH (a:PERSON)-[cico_r1:KNOWS]-(b:PERSON) WHERE ((a.countryName = $country) AND (a.id < b.id)) WITH DISTINCT a, b MATCH (country:PLACE) WHERE ((country.name = $country) AND (country.type = 'Country')) WITH DISTINCT country, a, b MATCH (b) WHERE ((b.countryName = country.name) AND (country.type = 'Country')) WITH DISTINCT country, a, b RETURN a.id AS a, b.id AS b, country.id AS c

cases.query: MATCH (s:PERSON {id: $pid})-[path:KNOWS* SHORTEST 1..$maxd]-(e:PERSON) WHERE length(path) >= 2 MATCH (e)-[:ISLOCATEDIN]->(city:PLACE)-[:ISPARTOF]->(country:PLACE {name: $country}) WHERE city.type = 'City' AND country.type = 'Country' RETURN e.id AS e, length(path) AS d
cases.output: MATCH (s:PERSON)-[path:KNOWS* SHORTEST 1..3]-(e:PERSON) WHERE (((s.id = $pid) AND (length(path) >= 2)) AND (e.countryName = $country)) RETURN e.id AS e, length(path) AS d
cases.detail: valid only for the given values of $maxd

cases.query: MATCH (a:PERSON)-[:KNOWS]-(b:PERSON) WITH a, b, 0 AS score OPTIONAL MATCH (a)-[:LIKES]->(m:MSG)-[:HASCREATOR]->(b) WITH DISTINCT a, b, score + (CASE WHEN m IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 10 END) AS score RETURN a.id AS a, b.id AS b, score
cases.output: MATCH (a:PERSON)-[:KNOWS]-(b:PERSON) WITH a, b, 0 AS score OPTIONAL MATCH (a)-[cico_k:KNOWS]->(b) OPTIONAL MATCH (b)-[cico_k_:KNOWS]->(a) WITH a, b, score, CASE WHEN cico_k IS NOT NULL THEN coalesce(cico_k.likes_fwd, 0) > 0 WHEN cico_k_ IS NOT NULL THEN coalesce(cico_k_.likes_rev, 0) > 0 ELSE EXISTS { MATCH (a)-[:LIKES]->(m:MSG)-[:HASCREATOR]->(b) } END AS cico_exists WITH DISTINCT a, b, score + (CASE WHEN (NOT cico_exists) THEN 0 ELSE 10 END) AS score RETURN a.id AS a, b.id AS b, score

cases.query: MATCH (a:PERSON) OPTIONAL MATCH (a)-[:KNOWS]->(b:PERSON) WITH a, b OPTIONAL MATCH (a)-[:LIKES]->(m:MSG)-[:HASCREATOR]->(b) WITH DISTINCT a, b, m IS NULL AS missing RETURN a.id AS a, b.id AS b, missing
cases.output: MATCH (a:PERSON) OPTIONAL MATCH (a)-[:KNOWS]->(b:PERSON) WITH a, b OPTIONAL MATCH (a)-[cico_k:KNOWS]->(b) OPTIONAL MATCH (b)-[cico_k_:KNOWS]->(a) WITH a, b, CASE WHEN cico_k IS NOT NULL THEN coalesce(cico_k.likes_fwd, 0) > 0 WHEN cico_k_ IS NOT NULL THEN coalesce(cico_k_.likes_rev, 0) > 0 ELSE EXISTS { MATCH (a)-[:LIKES]->(m:MSG)-[:HASCREATOR]->(b) } END AS cico_exists WITH DISTINCT a, b, (NOT cico_exists) AS missing RETURN a.id AS a, b.id AS b, missing

cases.query: MATCH (p:PERSON) RETURN p.id AS p, COUNT { MATCH (m:MSG)-[:HASCREATOR]->(p) } AS c
cases.output: MATCH (p:PERSON) RETURN p.id AS p, (CASE WHEN p IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE CASE WHEN (p.msgCount IS NULL) THEN 0 ELSE p.msgCount END END) AS c

rules.path_carriers: semantics: needs relationship_uniqueness == 'isomorphism' (under homomorphism the ordinary QueryPart rewrite already applies)
